description: OWNER ONLY — file one X Space. payload is a JSON object string: space_id, url, title, host_handle, speaker_handles, started_at, ended_at, capture_method (live_captions or replay_transcript), listener_count, summary, synopsis, theses, tickers, ticker_sentiment, notable_quotes (text, caption_timestamp, speaker_handle; text must be a verbatim substring of transcript), transcript, our_opinion. Opinion is stored separately and labeled. Does not post. Requires an OWNER-tier key.
name: submit_spaces_intel
